answer: Every identity in an agent economy must post a refundable bond before earning fees. Random, unpredictable cross-checks test whether identities coordinate as one operator; a detected Sybil loses its bond, and linked partners lose eligibility. Agents operating across zenith, grove, and tundra markets can gain reputation through successful checks, while an attacker must lock fresh capital for each fake identity and absorb a growing expected loss as the attack scales.
